results.heading: Booking an appointment
results.text: New and existing patients can book by email or phone. Tell us what the visit is for (check-up, pain, hygiene, whitening) and two or three preferred days; reception confirms a time.

results.heading: Emergencies
results.text: For dental emergencies outside opening hours, call the emergency line listed on your appointment confirmation. Email is not monitored outside opening hours.

results.heading: Price list — what treatments cost
results.text:
All prices are in Turkish lira and include VAT. These are the fees for standard treatments.

- Check-up and consultation: ₺900
- Hygiene visit (scale and polish): ₺1,500
- Composite filling (per tooth): ₺2,000 – ₺3,500 depending on size
- Teeth whitening (in-clinic): ₺6,000
- Panoramic X-ray: ₺700

results.heading: Visit length
results.text: Check-ups and hygiene visits take 30 minutes. Fillings take 45–60 minutes. Whitening takes 90 minutes.

results.heading: Price list — what treatments cost
results.text:
All prices are in Turkish lira and include VAT. These are the fees for standard treatments.

- Check-up and consultation: ₺900
- Hygiene visit (scale and polish): ₺1,500
- Composite filling (per tooth): ₺2,000 – ₺3,500 depending on size
- Teeth whitening (in-clinic): ₺6,000
- Panoramic X-ray: ₺700

results.heading: Before your visit
results.text: Eat normally unless we told you otherwise. Brush your teeth before coming. If you take blood thinners or have a heart condition, tell us when booking.

results.heading: Saturday
results.text: Saturday appointments are for check-ups and hygiene visits only; longer treatments are scheduled on weekdays.

results.heading: Cancellation policy
results.text: Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 24 hours before the appointment time. Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice, and missed appointments, are charged ₺500.

results.heading: Opening hours
results.text: Nova Dental Clinic is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and on Saturday from 10:00 to 14:00. We are closed on Sundays and on national public holidays.
